name: Grilled Veggie Sausage & Bell Peppers with Creamy Dill Potato Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and quarter bell peppers. Place in a large bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; toss to combine.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add peppers (reserve bowl for the next step) and cook, turning occasionally, until soft, 7-8 minutes. Transfer peppers to a plate and cover with aluminum foil (reserve grill pan for later use).
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot; add to the bowl.

Return grill pan to medium heat. Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
When the potatoes are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Add potatoes to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; stir to combine the potato salad.
Slice cooked peppers into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide potato salad, peppers, and sausages between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
